meta.name: common-issues
meta.description: Known issues and their solutions in the Trezor Suite monorepo. Use when encountering build failures, test failures, or environment problems.

copy.tagline: 快速排查 Trezor Suite 构建与测试问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在 Trezor Suite 开发中遇到构建或测试报错
copy.tagline_en: Quickly troubleshoot Trezor Suite build and test issues
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you encounter build or test failures in Trezor Suite development

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能识别 Trezor Suite 项目中的常见构建、测试失败和环境问题，并给出具体的解决命令或检查方法。
howto.when: 当用户询问或遇到 Trezor Suite 项目中的构建失败、测试失败、网络超时或类型错误时触发。

say.text: Playwright 测试失败了，怎么办？
构建失败了，可能是依赖变化。
say.note: Claude 会提示运行 yarn build:libs。
Claude 会建议使用最窄的 TypeScript 检查。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will identify and explain common build, test failure, and environment issues in the Trezor Suite monorepo, providing specific commands or solutions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when users ask about or encounter build failures, test failures, network timeouts, or type errors in the Trezor Suite project.

say_en.text: Playwright tests are failing, what should I do?
say_en.note: Claude suggests using yarn --mode=skip-build during installation.

say_en.text: Build failed, maybe due to dependency changes.

say_en.note: Claude advises using the narrowest TypeScript check available.
